verdicts.reason: A: the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is pulled out into a separate right-hand column level with the quote, so it competes with the quote instead of sitting under it. The SOLSTICE logo floats mid-canvas between the quote and the can, lined up with neither, and the can sits off-centre at the edge of its circle, which looks accidental. B makes the same attribution split, and the logo sitting centred under left-aligned text looks arbitrary. But the attribution reads as deliberate inside the lilac circle, the can is centred on its maroon circle, and the quote block is tighter. The big empty lower-right corner is still a flaw.
